subject: Error in if (e == 0) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

messages.author: 3400b8d5f3b5f072
messages.subject: Error in if (e == 0) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
parts:
Hi Chris, 

I realize this is similar to a post below by maik.h, but the error message is slightly different plus I tried the solutions for that problem and they didn't fix my issue. 

When I run the following line of code: 
mod.ID2736.W1.HR <- ctmm.select(ID2736.W1.HR, CTMM = GUESS2736, verbose=TRUE)

I get the following error and warning messages: 
Error in if (e == 0) { : missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed
In addition: Warning messages:
1: In cov.loglike(hess, grad) : MLE is near a boundary or optim() failed. (repeated 4 times)
5: In log(apply(sRes, 1, det)) : NaNs produced
6: In sqrt(prod(e)) : NaNs produced
7: In log(e[1]/e[2]) : NaNs produced

This happens for only one of the 40 individuals I am trying to create home ranges for, and happens when I run the individual by itself, or in a loop with the other 39 individuals. This individual only has six points that are usable for the home range, so I'm wondering if this is just an error related to the fact that there not enough points to create a home range in the first place, thus inserting an NA somewhere there shouldn't be? 

Thanks in advance,
Aaron

Hi Aaron,

If you can message/email me a minimal working example (data + script), then I can take a look at it. 6 locations should be enough to not return any errors, though the estimate itself may not be informative.

Best,
Chris
